blueprint.title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
blueprint.description: Offer internet packages based on the user's residential address and provide available internet packages for the selected address.

data.description: Setup internet subscription for user address. Port allocation fails with NOT_AVAILABLE_PORT error — agent asks supervisor, supervisor instructs to notify user and complete.
data.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT 
User.Address = GetUserAddress()
bbk = GetBBKByAddress(User.Address)
inventory = GetInventory(bbk)
IF inventory.Available == TRUE THEN
    products = GetProductBySpeed()
    selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection(products)
    result = PortAllocation(selectedProduct.serial_number)
    IF result.error == "NOT_AVAILABLE_PORT" THEN
        AskSupervisor()
        NotifyUser()
        Complete()
    END_IF
END_IF
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE
